title: Two agents, one book
subtitle: wisp desk demo on a SPY options OKF bundle
bullets: Local-first knowledge store with section-level changesets and actors
Live script: `python3 demo/desk/desk_demo.py all --fresh`
Bundles: `demo/workspaces/primary` + `demo/workspaces/replica` (sync peer)
speaker: Pitch in one line: accountable autonomy — agents commit to the same ledger, not parallel chat memories.

title: Why not two RAG silos?
bullets: Duplicate narratives with no merge semantics or losing-side replay
No per-section provenance (`--input`, `why`) tied to commits
Erasure and compliance are afterthoughts; audit is chat export
speaker: Contrast vector DB + transcripts with a single OKF bundle every agent reads and writes through wisp.

title: Step 0 — SEED
bullets: Source: your recorded week in `docs/test` (gitignored scratch store)
`--fresh` copies → `demo/workspaces/primary` and clones `demo/workspaces/replica`
Prereq: `cargo build -p wisp-cli --release`
speaker: Reset safe: demo never touches your scratch bundle unless you point `--demo` at it.

title: Act 1 — Live stub + provenance
bullets: Fixture feed: `fixtures/oct14_feed.json` (stub tick, not live market data)
`add-section` on Wed observation after “Cash session”
`--input observations/2026-10-13-spy-options-session` links prior day
Then `log -n 1` and `why` on the observation path
commands: wisp add-section observations/2026-10-14-spy-options-session --after=<section> --heading='Live desk stub (demo)' --content=... --input observations/2026-10-13-spy-options-session -m 'Hawk: intraday break stub @ 10:35'
speaker: Show the inputs graph: today's stub cites yesterday's observation as a first-class edge.

title: Act 2 — Bear vs Hawk merge
bullets: Target: `strategy/2026-10-14-ex-post-optimal-play` (one section, two stories)
`process:bear/1.0` on `task/bear-demo`: fade breakdown narrative
`process:hawk/1.0` on `main`: break 772 confirmed
Merge conflict → `demo-resolutions.json` with `take: theirs` (Bear wins)
Ledger keeps both agent changesets; merge node on `process:wisp-merge`
commands: wisp switch task/bear-demo && wisp update strategy/...#<section> --base=<ver> -m 'Bear: fade breakdown' --content=...
wisp switch main && wisp update strategy/...#<section> --base=<ver> -m 'Hawk: breakdown confirmed' --content=...
speaker: Conflict is scope-keyed; resolution skips the losing edit chain without deleting history.

title: Act 3 — Erase + replica sync
bullets: Erase Fri observation **Options** section (`--reason policy`, `--discard`)
Keyword search `max pain`: top hit was Fri Options; after erase, Fri file no longer contains phrase
Journal may still mention “max pain” — section erasure ≠ whole-doc delete
`remote add` + `push` from demo; replica `pull origin` mirrors managed markdown
commands: wisp remote add replica file://<demo-replica> --trusted && wisp push replica
wisp pull origin   # on replica, origin → demo
speaker: Policy erasure propagates through sync; prove replica matches primary on disk and index.

title: Act 4 — Auditor replay
bullets: `fsck` — 8 changesets, hot refs OK, no problems (demo run)
`log -n 5` — erase, merge, hawk, bear, act1 stub visible with actors
Grounded Q&A: `search` (auto) + `cat` sections — no LLM required for audit trail
commands: wisp search 'What was the ex-post play on the Friday flush day?' --mode auto
speaker: Close with: compliance reads the ledger; investigators don't reconstruct from Slack.

title: What to remember
bullets: Actors: `human:*`, `process:bear/1.0`, `process:hawk/1.0`, `process:wisp-merge`
Section-level concurrency + merge resolutions + durable skip replay
Erase + sync for GDPR-style retraction without forked agent state
Optional Act 1 LLM: Scrypted `POST /generations/text/nova-pro` (see README)
speaker: Reset: `rm -rf demo/workspaces`. Narration: `desk_demo.py narrate`.
